subject.title: fix(exec-approval): distinguish non-persistable command from ask=always policy in approval prompt

question: Should maintainers repair this PR as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97069, or promote a broader sibling PR instead?
rationale: Multiple open candidate PRs target the same bug, and this branch still has code blockers plus a contributor proof gap, so choosing the canonical landing branch needs maintainer coordination.

options.title: Repair this PR before merge
options.body: Keep this focused branch open, require the typed-reader fix, full renderer coverage, and real prompt proof before treating it as canonical.

options.title: Promote a sibling canonical fix
options.body: If a broader sibling has cleaner coverage and proof, preserve this PR's useful context there and close this branch only after the chosen fix is viable or merged.

recommendation.title: Repair this PR before merge
